target.title: fix(slack): mark connected status degraded without bot identity
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When Slack `auth.test` fails at boot, or `channels.slack.botToken` is actually a user token (`xoxp` with `user_id` but no `bot_id`), Socket Mode can still connect while main previously published `healthState: "healthy"`. Operators see a connected channel while mention detection is disabled and required-mention rooms fail closed — silent inbound loss.

## Why This Change Was Made

Transport liveness (`connected: true`) remains useful, but advertising `healthy` is wrong when bot identity is missing under the current bot_id-gated contract (`botUserId = botId ? authUserId : ""`). Publish `healthState: "degraded"` with `lastError`, and log `slack socket mode connected (degraded identity)`.

## User Impact

- Misconfigured bot tokens / failed `auth.test` no longer look healthy in channel status.
- Valid bot-token installs stay `healthy` on connect.
- App Home slash-command wiring and allowlist-resolution formatting are untouched.

## Evidence

**Head SHA:** `ff1923940d74b10f2494ede912d72eb87391e11e`

### Rank-up coverage

| Rank-up | Status |
|---|---|
| Real Socket Mode startup proof (healthy + degraded) via `@slack/bolt` `app.start()` + patched `publishSlackConnectedStatus` / runtime logs | done — redacted transcript below |
| Fix `check-test-types` (`bot_id: undefined` → `never.trim`) | done — optional `bot_id?: string` fixture; omit property |
| Rotate pasted Slack credentials | **please rotate** `xoxb` / `xoxp` / `xapp` used for proof |

### L1 unit (provider-path)

- `marks socket mode degraded when boot identity is unavailable`
- `marks socket mode degraded for user_id without bot_id (bot-gated contract)` — typed as `{ user_id: string; bot_id?: string }` so `check-test-types` stays green

### L3 live Socket Mode startup (redacted) — 2026-07-13

Real `@slack/bolt` Socket Mode `App({ token, appToken, socketMode: true }).start()`, then the same identity gate + `publishSlackConnectedStatus` / runtime log contract used by patched `onStarted`. Tokens never printed (kind + last-6 only). **Rotate bot / user / app-level tokens — they were pasted into chat.**

```text
# Slack Socket Mode status proof — PR #105556
Time (UTC): 2026-07-13T16:23:03.567Z
Tokens never printed; kind + last-6 only. IDs redacted.

{
  "note": "Real @slack/bolt Socket Mode app.start() + patched publishSlackConnectedStatus onStarted contract",
  "token_kinds": { "bot": "xoxb-…109Tev", "user": "xoxp-…b4311c", "app": "xapp-…733989" },
  "results": [
    {
      "label": "A healthy bot token + app token (Socket Mode)",
      "ok": true,
      "authRaw": { "ok": true, "has_user_id": true, "has_bot_id": true },
      "identityDegraded": false,
      "statuses": [{ "connected": true, "healthState": "healthy", "lastError": null }],
      "logs": [
        "setStatus {\"connected\":true,\"healthState\":\"healthy\",\"lastError\":null}",
        "slack socket mode connected"
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "B user token misused as botToken + app token (Socket Mode degraded)",
      "ok": true,
      "authRaw": { "ok": true, "has_user_id": true, "has_bot_id": false },
      "identityDegraded": true,
      "statuses": [{
        "connected": true,
        "healthState": "degraded",
        "lastError": "Slack auth.test identified account \"default\" as user …REDACTED without bot_id. … replace it with a Bot User OAuth Token. …"
      }],
      "logs": [
        "WARN Slack auth.test identified account \"default\" as user …REDACTED without bot_id. …",
        "setStatus {\"connected\":true,\"healthState\":\"degraded\",\"lastError\":\"[set]\"}",
        "slack socket mode connected (degraded identity)"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "all_ok": true
}

ALL SCENARIOS PASSED
```

### Before / after contract

| Case | Live path | BEFORE (`main` onStarted) | AFTER (this PR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valid `xoxb` + `xapp` Socket Mode start | auth.test has `bot_id`; socket connects | always `healthy` | `healthState: healthy` + log `slack socket mode connected` |
| `xoxp` as botToken + `xapp` Socket Mode start | auth.test `user_id`, no `bot_id`; socket still connects | still `healthy` (bug) | `healthState: degraded` + warning `lastError` + log `… (degraded identity)` |

### Files

- `extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider-support.ts` — degraded option on `publishSlackConnectedStatus`
- `extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.ts` — `identityDegraded` gate on Socket `onStarted`
- `extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.reconnect.test.ts` — healthy / missing-identity / user-without-bot_id coverage (+ type fix)


## Agent Transcript

- Cursor session: Slack L3 live identity/status API proof (tokens redacted; rotate if exposed).
